headword: {損得勘定|そんとくかんじょう}
gloss: calculation of gain and loss; self-interested calculation

definitions.gloss: calculating what one stands to gain or lose
definitions.explanation: Weighing a decision strictly by what one will gain or lose, without regard for feeling, principle, or relationship. Usually used critically of someone acting out of pure self-interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{損得勘定|そんとくかんじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: He's very calculating about what he gains and loses.

examples.japanese: {損得勘定|そんとくかんじょう}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}った→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I helped out without thinking about what I'd get from it.

examples.japanese: {友人関係|ゆうじんかんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{損得勘定|そんとくかんじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{長続|ながつづ}きしない→長続きする：26885_nagatsuzukisuru⟧。
examples.english: If you bring calculations of gain and loss into a friendship, it won't last.

notes:
⟦{損得|そんとく}→損得：04404_sontoku⟧(gain and loss) + ⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧(calculation): weighing a decision purely by what one gains or loses from it.
